description: Retry only transient failures with injectable backoff.
turns: 修复 net.execute(operation, policy, sleep)。最多调用 operation 共 max_attempts 次，只重试 policy.retry_on 中的异常；其他异常立即原样抛出。每次重试前调用 sleep(delay)，delay 按 policy.delays 取值，超过列表后沿用最后一个； max_attempts 必须是正整数且 bool 不算整数，delays 不得为空或含负数。耗尽时原样抛出最后一次异常。

provenance.note: Curated multi-file repository scenario authored for picli; not a captured user failure or official benchmark.
